judgments.subject: structure.role_profile
judgments.conclusion: Agent instruction review is a selected specialist contract composed into the canonical implementation-reviewer role, not a second reviewer role or a panel-selection owner.

judgments.subject: structure.sections.diagnosis
judgments.conclusion: The compiled contract preserves the corrected distinction between source traceability or reviewer reconstruction and causal material actually available at the governed agent's effective loading boundary.

judgments.subject: structure.sections.result-and-remediation
judgments.conclusion: The specialist owns applicability and finding meaning while generic Implementation Review remains the unchanged nested provider-neutral admission result and Review Episode remains lifecycle and lineage owner.

judgments.subject: interface.boundaries.authority.advisory-only
judgments.conclusion: Compilation and runtime composition confer no mutation, architecture, proposal, reviewer-selection, implementation-approval, self-certification, or human authority.
